adminStats.title: Statistics
adminStats.retention: New users and retention, last {days} days (UTC)
adminStats.retentionNote: By day of creation: back the next day (D+1) and a week later (D+7). “—”: unknown, until the return day is over, or for a day before visits were first recorded (UserDay).
adminStats.firstSteps: First steps of new careers, last {days} complete days (UTC)
adminStats.firstStepsNote: By day of creation, weekly challenge left out: how far these careers have gone today. A career its player deleted is no longer counted; a career without an account never resumed after its first day may be purged after 14 days.
adminStats.firstStepsSummary: Over these {days} days: {saves, plural, =0 {no career} one {# career} other {# careers}}, first match played: {share}
adminStats.upkeep: Rows and upkeep of the largest tables
adminStats.upkeepNote: PostgreSQL's counters, kept from one start of Neon's compute to the next; the server last started on {since} UTC. Live rows, dead rows VACUUM must reclaim and their share, updates made in their page without a new index entry (HOT), the last autovacuum and how many, then the last autoanalyze.

admin.title: Administration
admin.lead: {period, select, 30 {The last 30 days} other {The last 7 days}} (UTC), from {first} to {last}.
admin.statsLink: Detailed statistics: tables, careers' first steps

sections.acquisitionNote: Visits: first visits of a public page, one per browser every 30 days, crawlers and existing players left out. New players: created over the period, without an account at their first career, or Google accounts.
sections.journeyNote: The period's new players, by source: career created, first match played, season finished; as a share of the source's visits.
sections.retentionNote: Back the day after they were created (D+1) and a week later (D+7), over the days whose return day is over; “—”: not known yet.
sections.activityNote: Players who came each day; matches of their clubs played to the end, live or simulated; launches of the installed app, one a session.
sections.healthNote: Size taken at each purge (every day, 04:17 UTC); growth over the last 7 days of snapshots; storage cost estimated on Neon's Launch plan, {price} per GB a month, and its projection {days} days ahead at this pace, flagged past {alert} a month; weight per new player: that growth divided by the players created over those days.

details.medianNote: from creating the career to the end of the match
details.purged: {users, plural, =0 {no player} one {# player} other {# players}}, {saves, plural, =0 {no career} one {# career} other {# careers}} and {challenge, plural, =0 {no challenge career} one {# challenge career} other {# challenge careers}}
details.appLaunches: from the home screen, one a session
details.newPlayers: {count, plural, =0 {no new player} one {# new player} other {# new players}} over those days
details.purgedInactive: of players without an account, not seen for 30 days
details.purgedOneDay: {users, plural, =0 {no player seen only on the day they started} one {of a player seen only on the day they started} other {of # players seen only on the day they started}}

challenge.title: Weekly challenge, week {week}
challenge.figures: {saves, plural, =0 {no career} one {# career} other {# careers}} of {max} · {entries, plural, =0 {no player entered} one {# player entered} other {# players entered}} · {submitted, plural, =0 {none ranked} one {# ranked} other {# ranked}} after 10 matchdays

errors.title: Errors
errors.note: Errors of the server and of browsers, grouped by UTC day and fingerprint (route and message, nothing personal), kept 30 days. For an error seen since this time yesterday, the 24 h count its UTC days of yesterday and today.
errors.other: Other errors (past {max} groups in the day)

cleanup.title: Event cleanup
cleanup.note: The goals of other matches kept as events before 9 November 2026, and the events and decisions of the managed club's matches in finished seasons: no screen reads them any more. One pass per maintenance call, by batches; a count deletes nothing.
cleanup.none: No cleanup pass over the period.
cleanup.latest: Left after the latest pass: {otherGoals, plural, one {# goal of other matches} other {# goals of other matches}}, {managedEvents, plural, one {# event} other {# events}} and {decisions, plural, one {# decision} other {# decisions}} of the managed club.
